get_get_border_agent_id_unsupported.description:
Your OTBR does not support Border Agent ID.

To fix this issue, update the OTBR to the latest version and restart Home Assistant.
If you are using an OTBR integrated in Home Assistant, update either the OpenThread Border Router app or the Silicon Labs Multiprotocol app. Otherwise update your self-managed OTBR.
get_get_border_agent_id_unsupported.title: The OTBR does not support Border Agent ID

insecure_thread_network.description:
Your Thread network is using a default network key or pass phrase.

This is a security risk, please create a new Thread network.
insecure_thread_network.title: Insecure Thread network settings detected

otbr_zha_channel_collision.description:
When OTBR and ZHA share the radio, they must use the same network channel.

If OTBR and ZHA attempt to connect to networks on different channels, neither Thread/Matter nor Zigbee will work.

OTBR is configured with a Thread network on channel {otbr_channel}, ZHA is configured with a Zigbee network on channel {zha_channel}.
otbr_zha_channel_collision.title: OTBR and ZHA share the same radio but use different channels
